answer: In an agent economy where agents trade saffron, map a nebula, or manage an oasis, payment rules can be governed by votes weighted by tokens locked in escrow for 90 days. Splitting 1,000 locked tokens among a thousand identities gives the same total voting power as staking them under one identity. To gain more influence, an attacker must acquire and lock more tokens, tying up capital and forgoing its use elsewhere.
